As a warehouse worker at DHL eCommerce in ‘s-Hertogenbosch, you work part-time, between 15 and 35 hours per week. You work in the evening (5:00 PM - 12:00 AM) or night (2:00 AM - 8:00 AM). The job is physically demanding, but you get a good salary in return. You sort parcels on the conveyor belt and help keep the logistics process running smoothly.
Your day starts with a short briefing. Then, the sorting process begins. Together with your colleagues, you make sure every parcel ends up in the right place. The work is repetitive, but you stay active throughout your shift. There is time for a short break. Since the job can be physically demanding, it’s important that you are fit.
This role suits you if you like to stay active and are ready for something new. No experience is required; we’ll teach you everything. Excited? Apply now and start your new job soon! 🚀

- Minimum pre-vocational (vmbo) working and thinking level

- You are at least 18 years old

- No experience required; s​tarters are welcome

- You speak Dutch or English

- You have your own transport because of the working hours

- You live within 30 km of ‘s-Hertogenbosch

- You are able to do physically demanding work

Enter the world of empty bottles, beer crates, and paper. Get started as a logistics employee at Kuehne + Nagel! 😍 And find out what happens to this stuff after they leave the supermarket! With a salary rising up to € 29,98 💰 (including allowances), you will have a flexible job! And enjoy together with your colleagues the most varied activities!

For this vacancy, it is important to have your own housing in the Netherlands. 🏠

Read on quickly and discover what we have to offer you! 👇🏼

What we offer
- A salary of € 14,99 without allowances! 💵
- Opportunities to grow to other positions!
- Earn up to € 29,98 including allowances!
- Travel allowance of € 0,25 per km! ✅
- Chance to get a permanent contract after 10 weeks
- Always the best music in the warehouse!

Who you are
To make sure that everything in the warehouse runs smoothly, you meet the following requirements:

- You are at least 18 years old, due to working hours;    
- You speak Dutch or English, for safety reasons;    
- You are available for at least 2 days a week;    
- You are physically capable of lifting crates up to 20 kg;
- You have your own means of transportation to get to Kuehne + Nagel in Zwolle.

What will you do
As a logistics employee, you are involved in many different tasks. And that is exactly what makes your job so much fun! 😎 All kinds of products come back from the supermarket to be recycled. Think about plastic bottles, paper, but also all the carts and crates. Your goal is to sort everything right out! ♻️ Each part has its own place. When everything is cleaned and transported, it will be picked up again by customers at Albert Heijn! Cool, right?!

At Kuehne + Nagel, working days are from Monday to Sunday. This means a lot of shifts! Your availability is the limit! Most shifts have the following times: 06:00 - 15:00, 14:45 - 23:45, and 21:15 - 06:15. ⏰ Together we will find your perfect schedule!

Go to work as an order picker at Arvato in Venlo and make sure that thousands of orders are shipped on time every day. You will work in a modern distribution center, earn €14.99 gross per hour, receive travel allowance, build up pension through Manpower, and have the opportunity to receive a contract with Arvato upon good performance. Read on quickly!

Your tasks at Arvato include:

    - Collecting products based on digital instructions
    
- Scanning items with a handheld scanner
    
- Processing and sorting goods in the warehouse
    
- Packing orders according to the applicable guidelines
    
- Applying shipping labels and transport documents
    
- Preparing shipments for transport

What's in it for you

    - Gross salary of €14.99 per hour
    
- Temporary employment contract through Manpower
    
- Opportunity for a contract with Arvato upon good performance
    
- Travel allowance according to Arvato’s regulations
    
- Pension accrual through Manpower
    
- Part-time or full-time position of 32 to 40 hours per week
    
- Additional allowances for shift work, overtime and changed working hours
    
- Working in a modern and automated distribution center

    - In possession of a valid Dutch work permit
    
- Basic knowledge of the English language to understand work instructions and communicate with colleagues
    
- Good numerical skills and an accurate way of working
    
- Good physical condition and no physical limitations that prevent you from performing the work
    
- Experience with a handheld scanner is a plus
    
- Available for at least 32 hours per week

Would you like to start working as an order picker at Arvato in Venlo? Don’t wait too long and apply today via Manpower. After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible to discuss the next steps.

As a Mechanical Maintenance Technician, your responsibilities include: Performing preventive maintenance on production machinery, conveyors, packaging lines, and utilities. Inspecting critical machine components such as bearings, chains, sensors, and seals. Diagnosing and repairing mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and basic hydraulic faults. Testing and releasing equipment after repairs. Carrying out inspections and condition monitoring to identify wear, leaks, unusual noises, and performance issues. Recording maintenance activities and findings in the CMMS. Installing, dismantling, and modifying machine components during maintenance and production changeovers. Assisting with technical improvements and production line optimizations. Working according to HACCP food safety and hygiene standards. Applying Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO) procedures to ensure safe maintenance activities. Collaborating closely with operators, engineers, planners, and fellow maintenance technicians. Supporting continuous improvement initiatives such as 5S, TPM, root cause analysis, and standardization projects. Managing spare parts responsibly and advising on critical stock levels. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A competitive salary based on your experience. A year-end bonus. 25 vacation days. Travel expense reimbursement. An excellent pension scheme. Opportunities for training and professional development. A stable, long-term position within a growing international organization. Functie-eisen You are a proactive technician who enjoys working in a team and takes ownership of technical challenges. You work safely, accurately, and have a strong focus on quality. You also have: An MBO Level 3 or 4 diploma (or international equivalent) in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Automation, Installation Technology, or a related technical discipline. Experience in industrial maintenance within a production or manufacturing environment. Knowledge of mechanical drives, bearings,

chains, gears, pneumatics, and basic hydraulics. Basic understanding of PLC inputs and outputs (programming experience is not required). Experience working with motors, sensors, frequency drives, and conveyor systems. Experience using a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) is an advantage. A valid VCA certificate, LOTO training, and NEN 3140 certification are beneficial, or willingness to obtain them. Good communication skills in English. Dutch is an advantage but not required. Hier kom je te werken As a Mechanical Maintenance Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring our production and packaging lines operate safely, efficiently, and reliably. You will carry out preventive maintenance, resolve mechanical breakdowns, and contribute to continuous improvements while maintaining the highest food safety and hygiene standards.

Do you want to work with the latest machines and innovative technologies for eye care that are used worldwide? Apply now! As a production operator, you work with modern and precise machines used to make lenses. Together with your team, you ensure that everything runs smoothly and that the quality is always top-notch. You spend a lot of time setting up and operating the machines, checking the products, and carefully applying chemicals to the lenses. The job requires precision and the ability to switch quickly. You ensure that production continues to run and that each pair of glasses meets the high quality standards.

To excel in this role, you are driven to achieve the highest possible results and adapt effortlessly to changing circumstances. You communicate clearly and openly, making you a valuable collaborative partner within the team. Furthermore, you possess:  - A VMBO/MBO education
 - You speak either English or Dutch
 - You have an eye for detail

Do you want to earn a good salary as an orderpicker employee? Go for an hourly wage of €16.94? Plus surcharges that go up to 60% on Friday nights and holiday pay of 8.33%?! Sounds amazing, right? That’s not all. At Albert Heijn in Delfgouw, you also receive a cold allowance of €0.32 per hour. Is this what you are looking for? Then you can start working at Albert Heijn for a long time. Yes!

Apply now and receive a WhatsApp message within 15 minutes with a few short questions so we can help you quickly. Don't have WhatsApp? Then we will contact you by phone or email!

What we offer
- Earn € 16,94 per hour (incl ADV allowance) (21+)
- Bonuses that rise up to 60% on Friday night!
- Holiday allowance of 8.33%
- Inside training for EPT with certificate!
- Enthusiastic colleagues around you
- A job for a longer period

Who you are
As an order picker, it is important that you are looking for a long-term job. Additionally, it is important that you meet the following requirements:

- You can speak English, Polish or Dutch
- You are at least 165 cm tall and you are at least 18 years or older
- You are physically fit enough to lift, for example, a crate of 20 kilos of bananas
- You are available minimum 2 day on the weekdays and on Saturdays from 07:00 a.m. - 03:30 p.m. and in the night from 10:30 p.m. - 07:00 a.m. (only night shifts are not possible)
- You have a recent logistic experience
- You can work in a refrigerated environment around 4 degrees. You will work in the fresh department
- You are available the whole week during your first week from Monday to Friday. This is to attend training so that you are familiar with the work processes
- You are available for at least 6 months!

What will you do

For our client located at De Run in Veldhoven, we are looking for a Cleanroom Repair Technician. Are you looking for a hands-on production role in a cleanroom environment? Then keep reading! 🛠

Your responsibilities include:

- Repairing, maintaining, and inspecting high-tech packaging and technical components.
- Inspecting products for quality and preparing them for reuse.
- Working from work instructions, checklists, and technical drawings.
- Performing repairs using hand tools.
- Registering completed work and carrying out basic administrative tasks in the system.
- Performing quality inspections and reporting any deviations.
- Working safely and accurately according to established procedures.
- Operating an EPT, stacker, forklift, or reach truck when required (not required for every position).
- Collaborating with colleagues to ensure an efficient, high-quality workflow.

Are you interested and do you recognize yourself in this profile? Apply now!

- Technical insight and an affinity for repair and maintenance work
- Able to read and understand technical drawings and work instructions (not required for every position)
- Accurate, quality-oriented, and detail-focused
- English language proficiency at B1 level or higher
- Experience operating an EPT, stacker, forklift, and/or reach truck, or willingness to obtain the required certificates (not required for every position)
- A true team player with a strong focus on safety
- Available to work full-time in a two-shift schedule

Imagine starting your day in a buzzing warehouse where no two days are ever the same. As a Warehouse Operative, you’ll become part of an enthusiastic and supportive team that keeps everything running smoothly behind the scenes. From the moment products arrive until they’re on their way to customers, you’ll play a key role in making it all happen.

You’ll move between different departments. Sometimes you’re receiving goods in inbound, other times you’re carefully picking and packing orders that need to go out the door. Every task you handle contributes to a seamless process, ensuring customers get exactly what they need, right on time.

Along the way, you’ll also get hands-on experience with equipment like forklifts, reach trucks, and OPT systems. Never used them before? That’s no problem, comprehensive training is provided so you can quickly gain confidence and expand your skills.

Teamwork is at the heart of this role. You’ll collaborate closely with your colleagues, supporting each other to hit daily targets and celebrating successes together. Accuracy and attention to detail are key, because every order counts and every customer matters.

This is more than just a warehouse role. It’s a chance to grow, learn, and become part of a dynamic environment where your contribution truly makes a difference.

Proficiency in English or Dutch is required.

- Good salary depending on your experience
- Direct contract with the employer
- Supportive working environment: training provided so you can develop your skills
- Dynamic and varied role: no two days are the same
- Career opportunities: chance to grow further in warehousing and logistics

At UPS, you’ll have the chance to work in a modern warehouse environment where no two days are the same. You and your new colleagues make sure that all parcels are sorted and end up at the right address. You’ll earn €15 per hour plus a shift allowance (depending on the shift). jobs.description:
Work on the engineering of custom-built superyachts Are you a Naval Architect or Marine Engineer based in Portugal and ready to take the next step in your international career? Xelvin is looking for a technically strong Naval Architect who wants to relocate to the Netherlands and work on high-end custom-built superyachts. In this role, you will contribute to the technical design and engineering of complex yacht projects. You will work on the translation of design concepts, client requirements and classification rules into technically feasible, safe and buildable solutions. This is a role for someone who understands ship design, structure, systems integration and the balance between aesthetics, performance, safety and manufacturability. What you will do As a Naval Architect, you will be involved in the engineering of luxury yachts from concept and basic engineering through detailed engineering and production support. Your responsibilities may include: Developing and checking technical ship design and engineering solutions. Working on hull design, general arrangements, layouts and technical integration. Supporting stability, weight control, structural design and construction-related calculations. Translating design concepts into technically feasible and buildable solutions. Preparing, reviewing and improving technical drawings, calculations and documentation. Coordinating with engineering teams, production, suppliers, classification societies and project stakeholders. Supporting the integration of systems, equipment, interiors and exterior elements into the overall yacht design. Identifying technical risks and proposing practical solutions. Ensuring that designs meet quality, safety, classification and production requirements. Supporting production teams during construction and resolving technical questions. Depending on your experience, the role can be more focused on basic engineering, detailed engineering, structural engineering, outfitting or technical

coordination. What Xelvin offers you Relocating to another country is a big step. Xelvin supports you throughout the full process, from the first interview to your first working day in the Netherlands. We offer: A full-time job with long-term perspective in the Netherlands. A gross monthly salary between €3,800 and €5,800, depending on experience and technical background. Relocation support from Portugal to the Netherlands. Help with documentation, registration and practical relocation matters. Guidance from our housing consultant in finding accommodation. Paid holidays and holiday allowance. Pension arrangement. Training and development opportunities. Personal guidance from Xelvin during the relocation process. A career opportunity in one of the most respected yacht-building regions in the world. What you bring For the Portuguese market, we are looking for candidates with a background in naval architecture, marine engineering, shipbuilding or complex mechanical engineering. You have: A technical degree such as Licenciatura or Mestrado in Naval Architecture, Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, Shipbuilding or a related field. Experience in shipbuilding, yacht building, marine engineering, offshore, naval design or complex technical engineering. Good understanding of ship design, construction principles and technical integration. Experience with 2D and/or 3D engineering software. Experience with software such as AutoCAD, Rhino, Siemens NX, SolidWorks, Inventor, Maxsurf, NAPA, ShipConstructor, Cadmatic or similar tools is relevant. Knowledge of stability, structures, weight control, hull design, outfitting or classification rules is a strong advantage. The ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications and engineering documentation. Strong problem-solving skills and a practical engineering mindset. Hey technical talent! Do you want to work with the very latest packaging machines in the fashion world? Check! A job where you have a direct impact on the e-commerce process of a global brand? Check! And also wonderful perks like a discount on Michael Kors products? 3x check! Then come work as a Machine Operator at Michael Kors in Venlo!

What we offer
- A competitive salary of €16,60 per hour
- Modern cafeteria with fresh food
-  Working in a creative, fast-paced team
- Mega discounts on Michael Kors and Versace!
- Extensive training by the machine supplier
- Pension plan and collective health insurance

Who you are
You have an eagle eye for technology and work in a super structured way. Furthermore, it is important that you:

- Have at least 2 years of experience in a technical production environment or as an operator (MBO-4 level)
- Have a good command of the English language, so you can easily connect with your international colleagues
- Are available on weekends when necessary (we do this together!)
- You live within a 50-kilometer radius of John Hicksstraat 1 in Venlo
- You have your own transportation to get to the location. The warehouse is not easily accessible by public transport.

What will you do
You are the 'boss' of our brand-new packaging machine in the e-commerce department. Your mission? Making sure the machine keeps purring like a happy cat! Together with your colleagues, you ensure all orders are packed neatly and at lightning speed. You perform minor maintenance tasks (Tier 1 support) and keep the machine dust-free and shiny. Do you spot a technical issue you can't fix yourself? Then you are the indispensable link between operations and the maintenance team to get it fixed. Is the machine done for a bit? Then you help your friendly colleagues in the department with other tasks. No two days are the same! #baanrader

Where will you work

Are you technically skilled and do you enjoy working on complex technical assemblies in a modern production environment? For an innovative high-tech company in the Tilburg region, we are looking for a Module Assembly Operator. In this role, you will work on high-quality modules where precision, craftsmanship, and quality are central within a technically advanced production environment where complex three-dimensional modules are assembled, welded, and tested according to strict quality standards.

As a Module Assembly Operator, you will be responsible for assembling and welding complex modules. You will work based on technical drawings and execute work orders according to planning. Your tasks include TIG welding components, including welding with orbital welding heads, and assembling parts into complete modules.

In addition, you will test, measure, and inspect the modules to ensure they meet all required quality and safety standards. You will operate machines, set them up, adjust them when necessary, and perform first-line maintenance to ensure the production process runs smoothly.

Besides the assembly and welding activities, you will carry out repair work and contribute to pilot projects and the development of new products. You will digitally register completed work orders in the system and support colleagues by sharing knowledge and providing instructions when needed.

Within this role, you are also expected to actively contribute ideas for improving processes and working methods. This is a technical and responsible position where technical insight, three-dimensional thinking, independence, and teamwork come together within a modern high-tech production environment.

- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings
- Strong spatial and technical 3D insight
- Good command of English
- Experience with metalworking
- Minimum MBO level 3 education in a technical field (preferably mechanical engineering or mechatronics)

As a production employee in this two-shift work schedule, you are goint to work in a dynamic environment where quality and precision are paramount. You will work from Monday to Friday in varying shifts from 6:00 AM to 3:00 PM and from 3:00 PM to midnight. Because of these shifts, you are entitled to a shift allowance starting from 6:00 PM, and you also receive a dressing allowance of 3.35 Euros per day. Due to the allowance, your hourly wage from 6:00 PM will be 18.75 Euros. You have a 40-minute break of which you get 10 minutes from the boss, so you can change clothes at a relaxed pace. This position offers excellent opportunities for advancement and opportiunities to further develop your skills; for example, you could grow into an operator position in the future.

You start your workday with a short team meeting where the goals for the day are discussed. After that, you begin your tasks, such as operating production machines, checking the quality of the products, process the necessary documentation, manual production work, and packaging products. Hygiene and safety are crucial, so you work according to strict protocols in the cleanroom. Collaborating with your team is essential to ensure the production runs smoothly. Do you have a friend/partner you like to work with? That’s possible! Apply together for this job posting and who knows, you might be working together in the cleanroom soon.

Are you ready to make a difference in a growing production company? Apply now and take the next step in your career!

- Experience with production machines
- Familiarity with hygiene protocols
- Good command of the English language
- Team-oriented and precise
